data.summary:
Highly competent, Hands-on & performance-driven management professional bringing 20+ years of expertise in the world of digital transformation, and enterprise technology, in the Fintech, Retail, Energy & Utility domains by relentlessly driving for innovation, growth, and impact defining every endeavor. As a Senior Program Manager at PayPal, steering high-stakes programs with precision, ensuring seamless execution across credit collections for consumers and merchants, enterprise, risk and regulatory. A leader in cloud computing, Voice Agentic AI, Agentic AI Chatbot, data engineering, and regulatory compliance, digital payments, credit collections, BNPL, consumer lending platform, merchant lending platform, and fraud detection. Bridging technology with business strategy, wielding expertise in governance, P&L management, and stakeholder engagement, and securing high-value partnerships across NA, EMEA, LATAM, and APAC. An agile transformation specialist, optimizing workflows, fostering collaboration, and driving operational resilience in global financial ecosystems.
Mastering the art of turning red-status projects into success stories, having led multi-million-dollar portfolios and scaled
operations from $2.5M to $10M, while managing teams of 100+ experts. Armed with an M.S. from BITS Pilani, B.E. from Bangalore University, PRINCE2 & CSM certifications, and a collection of prestigious awards, the journey is a relentless pursuit of excellence, disruption, and game-changing innovation in the financial world.
Proven track record of successfully delivering complex programs, including both new initiatives and red-status recoveries, ensuring seamless execution and value realization.
Skilled in driving product & technology planning through dependency commit in Jira, “Now”, “Next” and “Later” refinement of roadmap, agile methodologies, lean tools, and data-driven decision-making to improve financial product delivery and operational resilience.
Deep understanding of digital payments, BNPL (Buy Now Pay Later), Collections platforms for Consumers and Merchants, and AI-powered financial insights, ensuring seamless product development, compliance, and market adoption.
Led high-impact programs leveraging Jira, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Google Gemini, Java, .NET, Python, SQL, MongoDB, Azure Cloud, Data Engineering, Data Visualization, AI/ML-driven financial analytics, Informatica IICS, Full Stack Web & Mobile App Development, DevOps, SIEM, OpenText, and SAP to enhance financial product offerings and regulatory compliance.
Led high-impact platform-migration and cloud-migration programs to successful completion. •
Established efficient workflows for delivering projects/programs in payment systems, collections, digital lending, credit risk assessment, and financial data processing, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, enhanced collaboration, and real-time visibility into operations.
Managed $10M in annual revenue and a team of 100 experts, successfully scaling a FinTech account from $2.5M to $10M by optimizing product delivery, enhancing operational efficiency, and ensuring regulatory alignment.
Extensive experience in ecosystems across NA, EMEA, LATAM, and APAC, working with major organizations such as PayPal, Chubb, Shell, Thomson Reuters, Thames Water, Nike, and Hanes. Six years of on-site experience in the USA & UK, driving innovation and operational excellence.
Expertise in account governance, pre-sales support, P&L management, and stakeholder engagement to secure high- value projects and partnerships.

experience.role: Senior Program Manager (TPMO - Technical Program Management Office)
responsibilities: Program leadership, ensuring business strategy is seamlessly integrated with product and engineering, resulting in achieving the desired business benefit.

Managing around fifteen high-impact initiatives in the Credit Collections portfolio (Consumer, Merchant and Regulatory), driving
execution oversight throughout the program lifecycle, governance, and managing risks.

Fostering cross-functional collaboration across Business, Strategy, Product, Engineering, Risk & Compliance, Legal, Operational Excellence, Operations, and Vendor Management (including third-party), to achieve critical program milestones.
Leading executive-level engagements, ensuring strategic alignment and cross-functional synergy to support business and operational priorities.

Optimizing resources, enhancing service delivery, and ensuring regulatory compliance by leveraging financial and operational insights
to drive efficiency, budget precision, and long-term business growth.
Leading end-to-end Program Management for the Credit Collections portfolio, ensuring seamless execution and alignment with business objectives.

Implementing robust tracking and governance mechanisms, ensuring transparency in project status, key milestones and RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies) management, proactively identifying, and mitigating potential challenges to ensure program success.
Spearheaded the cloud migration from on-premise Netezza to Microsoft Azure to a modern, strategic architecture, ensuring business continuity and compliance.

Owned and managed a $3M annual revenue portfolio, driving delivery excellence across Data & Analytics accounts in the Insurance and
Reinsurance domains (Chubb).
Led the turnaround of two high-risk, red-status accounts, successfully stabilizing operations, restoring client confidence, and securing contract renewals with additional headcount expansion.
Played a pivotal role in pre-sales initiatives, contributing to a robust $15M sales pipeline through domain expertise and strategic client engagements.

Account Management & Leadership Reviews – Oversaw growth strategy, profitability, staffing, risk & issue management across
multiple accounts.
Change & Risk Management – Led quality assurance, root-cause analysis, and risk mitigation to ensure smooth and efficient project execution.
Financial & Contract Governance – Managed contract negotiations, invoice management, and commercial oversight to align financials with delivery objectives.
Client Engagement & Strategic Partnerships – Maintained a continuous feedback loop with client leadership, fostering transparency, trust, and long-term collaboration.

By driving data-driven digital transformation in the Insurance & Reinsurance sector, successfully delivered scalable analytics solutions, enhanced data quality, and enabled clients to make informed business decisions—leading to revenue growth, operational stability, and long-term client trust.

Owned and managed a $10M annual revenue portfolio, overseeing the delivery of all accounts within the FinTech domain (PayPal). • Drove exponential growth in a key FinTech account, scaling revenue from $2.5M to $8M through consistent delivery excellence.
Established an Offshore Development Centre (ODC) and streamlined delivery processes to enhance efficiency.
Successfully turned around a high-risk, red-status account in the transportation domain, stabilizing operations, restoring customer confidence, and securing a contract renewal.
Actively contributed to pre-sales initiatives, leveraging deep domain expertise to drive new business opportunities.
Internal Leadership Reviews – Oversaw account management, including growth strategy, margin optimization, staffing, risk & issue management.

o Facilitated daily standups to ensure alignment and progress tracking. o Led sprint planning, protecting teams from scope creep and ensuring realistic commitments. o Engaged in sprint reviews, capturing valuable stakeholder feedback for iterative improvements. o Conducted retrospectives, identifying key areas for continuous improvement. • Risk & Issue Management, Root-Cause Analysis, and Change Management to ensure high-quality deliveries. • Contract & Invoice Management, ensuring seamless financial and operational alignment with client expectations. • Maintained an ongoing client leadership review & feedback loop to drive transparency and sustained collaboration.

By combining deep FinTech domain expertise, strong governance, and agile best practices, successfully delivered scalable, high-impact solutions that improved customer confidence, drove revenue growth, and ensured seamless digital transformations for global clients.

Spearheaded the platform migration from a legacy infrastructure & application version to a modern, strategic architecture, ensuring business continuity and compliance.

Upgraded the Sample Manager application (a Platinum CoS application) alongside the infrastructure to align with the latest technology standards & led governance reporting, change management, and risk management, and conducted root cause analysis to ensure seamless project execution.
Successfully led and delivered a high-value £800K fixed-price program, ensuring all milestones were met on time with full payment received.
Achieved an outstanding 7/7 customer satisfaction rating. Effectively collaborated with multiple third-party vendors, including Thermo Fisher and Primary/Secondary Data Centres in London.

Managed and delivered multiple projects under IMASD, focusing on maintenance, enhancements, and support for critical applications,
including: o EP Livelink o EP Online Portal o Orchestra o EP Records Management o
SharePoint PDT
Oversaw governance reporting, change management, and risk management, and performed root cause analysis to enhance system efficiency and reliability.

standardization_metadata.duration_policy: Year precision: annual-resolution estimates from year-label differences, including current reference year for current roles; months are estimated years times 12, not known elapsed months. Year-label unions use common annual boundaries only for computation; no employment month is inferred. Month precision: elapsed calendar months (approximate). Day precision: completed calendar units. Aggregate unions use first-of-month boundaries for month-only dates; residual days use 365.2425/12 days per month, rounded to one decimal year.
